body:
she wrote "our song" so she'd have something to play at her school talent show. that's it. that's the origin story. 😭

no co-writers, no studio polish yet — just a teenager with a guitar, needing three minutes of material. it went on to become a genuine chart phenomenon, holding the top spot on Billboard's Hot Country Songs list for six straight weeks.

and per Billboard's own record books, nobody younger has ever pulled that off completely solo — writing it AND performing it herself, top to bottom.

pulling this photo from right around that same stretch of her career — same guitar-and-nerves energy this whole story started with.
